answer: To deter Sybils without identity documents, require one memory-hard admission puzzle per earning slot and set rewards by verified compute rather than account count; each round uses a fresh salt so old proofs cannot be replayed. Auditors reproduce sampled proofs and remove credits earned from invalid work. The shale ledger records each ticket, an umber marker identifies its round, and an atlas map exposes reused proofs. More names then bring no extra earnings unless they also supply costly, verifiable work.
